cover: Drone strikes on homes kill families
Strike on Shati flat kills family of four
Khalid, Imam bail sent to larger bench

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.figlab: killed in drone strikes on homes
stories.place: Ed Damazin and El Roseires, Blue Nile
stories.head: Drone strikes on homes kill families
bullets: 14 of the dead came from three families, residents said.
Officials imposed a night curfew after the strikes.
Officials blamed the RSF and SPLM-N; no response reported.

stories.label: Palestine
stories.figlab: killed in one flat, incl. girls of 15 and 13
stories.head: Strike on Shati flat kills family of four
bullets: A Hamas security official was killed with his family.
Gaza's interior ministry called it a 'heinous crime'.

stories.label: India · Detention
stories.head: Khalid, Imam bail sent to larger bench
bullets: The court refused interim bail for Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam.
A three-judge bench will rule on bail curbs under UAPA.
Delhi Police must reply to the bail pleas by 14 Dec.

stories.label: India · Assembly
stories.figlab: trees at risk from a 10-lane road
stories.head: Tree-felling protesters detained
bullets: Over a dozen people, including activists, were detained.
Two women allege police pushed and dragged them.
Police say protests are barred within 1 km of the Assembly.
